top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov on B008) rewards a mature, replicated chain from human incretin physiology (Holst), through the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), to proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology (Drucker). It is confirmed by large independent outcome trials for glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The citation names the physiology and active form and says they made the therapies possible, without crediting analogue engineering. Residual weaknesses are Mojsov's priority relative to Habener and the omission of Knudsen, but they do not outweigh the achievement, so an award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to the GLP-1 candidates
